limitations: One generalized Census population; related source layers, single rings only.

Managed counters omit retained workspace and native WPF allocation.
WPF rows fail the predeclared numerical budget; speed is a different-quality comparison.
No CPU affinity or frequency lock; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
